title: Thalathat al-Usool: Explanation of Thalaathatul al-Usool (The Three Fundamental Principles)
description: Explanation of Imam Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab's Thalathat al-Usool (The Three Fundamental Principles) - the short matn on which Salafi creed teaching is founded. Every Muslim must know these three foundations: knowledge of Allah, knowledge of His religion, and knowledge of His Prophet (peace be upon him). Taught by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan. Includes the printed annotated text (PDF) from Madeenah.com - a Salafi text library that freely shares its content with attribution.
short_description: The first text of Salafi Islamic learning, explained
